Defeat the [[warden]]s at the Dredge temple in [[Ferndale]].

==Quest information==

===Objectives===
* Eliminate the wardens that threaten the Temple of the Dredge.
* See Moleneaux for your reward.

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 750 [[Kurzick Faction]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* [[Equipment Requisition]]

=== Environmental changes ===
* Once this quest is completed, [[Warden of Saprophytes]] will no longer [[spawn]] in Ferndale.

==Walkthrough==
Go to the Temple of the Dredge and destroy the group of [[warden]]s there. When finished, return to speak with [[Moleneaux]]. Only the boss [[Warden of Saprophytes]] need be killed to complete the quest.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Moleneaux
:''"It is good to see you again, <character name>. We are even worse off than before, though I convinced many to withdraw from contact with the [[Kurzick]]s. We had thought to take this ruin as our home, at least for a while, but these creatures called wardens will not give us a moment's peace. And so more of my people die. I really cannot take much more of this, <character name>. None of us can. Please destroy the '''wardens''' before they destroy our dream of freedom!"''
{{offer dialog
|accept = Cheer up, friend. I'll take care of them.
|decline = Was it really so bad back in the [[Shiverpeak Mountains|Shiverpeaks]]?
|ask = My people are homeless while the '''wardens''' control that temple. Please help, we only want to live in peace! 
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Moleneaux
:''"You have the thanks of my clan. It is good to know that honorable humans exist in this place."''

==Notes==
*It is closer to begin this quest from [[House zu Heltzer]] or [[Saint Anjeka's Shrine]] than from [[Moleneaux]]'s location.
*The temple is also a key location in other quests, so it is possible to simultaneously finish or move along [[Melodic Gaki Flute]], [[Charting the Forests]], [[The Experimental Weaponsmith]] and [[The Beak of Darkness]].
